clips.caption:
He didn't invent any of this. He built a business worth billions using it - but according to the man introducing him on this call, the real credit goes further back than the business.

"Kevin was the first person to really expose me to the information that was taught by the secret societies," his mentee said, introducing him. Not a theory he read about. Material he was trained in, inside a secret society, for years.

That's the part almost nobody teaching success today can actually say about where they learned it.

clips.send: Send this to someone who keeps saying they want change but never commits - unease at seeing why nothing moves.
clips.caption:
Most people never actually decide. They say they want something - a new car, more income, to lose the weight - and nothing moves, because wanting isn't deciding.

The moment you actually decide, something shifts. Not metaphorically - he describes watching it happen in people's energy field in real time, the instant the decision lands. Before that moment, the universe is yawning at you.

"When you make a decision, the whole universe stands up and everything changes." That's not poster language. That's the mechanism.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to tell a real decision from a wish.

#manifestation #subconscious #awakening #universe #consciousness #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send this to a friend who dreams huge but never breaks it into steps - awe at the missing piece.
clips.caption:
Gordon Ramsay once told him something that reshaped how he teaches manifesting: you have to have a dream, but you can't live in a dream world.

So picture what you want. Feel it as if it's already yours. Then do the part almost everyone skips - break that big dream down into something you can actually reach in six months to a year. Not the dream itself. A chief aim.

The dream can be unreasonable. That's the whole point of a dream. But the step in front of you has to be real, with your feet still on the ground.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to break down your own dream this way.

#manifestation #mindset #awakening #subconscious #consciousness #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send this to someone who was told to suppress their anger completely - relief at being allowed to use it instead.
clips.caption:
There's no such thing as bad energy. There's just energy - the same way there's no such thing as a bad cloud, just a contracted one and an expanded one.

That anger about your life right now, the one you've been told to meditate away? Don't bury it. Use it. Esther Hicks calls it a rocket of desire. Napoleon Hill calls it a burning desire. Either way, that contracted, furious energy is exactly what launches what you actually want into motion.

You don't get the burning desire without the contraction first. The rage is the fuel, not the enemy.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to point that fuel somewhere useful.

#manifestation #subconscious #awakening #consciousness #energy #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send this to a friend chasing a raise they think will finally fix everything - awe at proof that it won't.
clips.caption:
One of the earliest people at Google retired in his thirties worth more money than most people can imagine.

Kevin asked him directly: when you were starting out, broke, were you happy? "I was so happy. It was unbelievable." And once the money actually came? "Not really. If anything, I became a little less happy - all the stress and pressure."

The feeling never changed. He felt the same joy building it broke as he did after the fortune arrived. The money was never what he was actually chasing.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what he says was actually missing.

#manifestation #subconscious #awakening #consciousness #mindset #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send this to someone who keeps a vision board they never look at again - awe at that being the whole point.
clips.caption:
A guy told Kevin a story that still gets him excited to repeat it.

Years ago, he grabbed a piece of paper and wrote down about twenty things he wanted. Then he put it away and completely forgot about it - moved apartments, moved on with life, never looked at it again.

Four years later, going through old boxes, he found the paper. Every single thing on that list had manifested. He hadn't been chasing any of it. He'd just written it down once and let it go.

There's something in that letting go that the wanting itself actually blocks.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the exact method for writing your own list.

#manifestation #subconscious #awakening #universe #consciousness #kevintrudeau
